description: Fetch period-specific operating KPIs and unit-economics metrics for one exact Bullrun ticker: ARR, net revenue retention, RPO, billings, customer counts, payments volume, cross-border volume, processed transactions, or other domain-specific metrics when populated. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

category.description: Optional category filter such as SaaS, payments, marketplace, banking, or other domain labels.

metricKey.description: Optional exact metric key to filter, e.g. ARR, NRR, RPO, BILLINGS, PAYMENT_VOLUME.

ticker.description: The ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun, e.g. "CRWD", "SNOW", "V".

name: get_operating_kpis
title: Get operating KPIs
